overview: Based on the published agenda, the Rothschild/Schofield Aquatic Center Commission was scheduled to meet to review the 2026 aquatic season and plan for the 2027 season and budget. The meeting was also set to address updates regarding the Cedar Creek Recreation Area and aquatics newsletter.
